old_problem: The Master uses opaque domain label `NM` while its filter is `TEMP_IBC_NM`; neither source nor public standards prove an acronym expansion or that this temperature record is the complete domain. Historical review treated that OEM mapping and the 1/2/18 numbering gap as Engineering Decisions rather than parameterizable platform metadata.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict without expanding or guessing `NM`. The executable standard behavior is complete read-only SDR/Sensor-list collection plus Web evidence. The versioned Project SPEC defines the physical FRU/domain instances, maps `TEMP_IBC_NM` and all companion records, and supplies expected values; this is permitted runtime configuration under ED-03/36. The source label/filter mismatch remains traceable but no longer blocks a complete per-member test. Criteria 1/2/18 are the only written checks; missing numbers are not invented.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2016, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and ipmitool/OpenBMC documentation were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2017 / Wistron-BMC-01037-V002 / 56b9d2b4274925b6.
IPMI defines generic SDR/sensor collection, but `NM` and `TEMP_IBC_NM` are OEM/platform names; standard command semantics must remain separate from OEM identity/expected-value mapping.
A Project SPEC can bind opaque `NM` instance IDs/FRUs/locations to `TEMP_IBC_NM` and any additional records without changing the original label or guessing an expansion.
Full raw lists before filtering allow the approved crosswalk to detect that TEMP_IBC_NM is partial, renamed, duplicated or absent instead of assuming completeness.
The explicit acceptance remains SDR, Sensor List and Web parity. The 1/2/18 labels are a source formatting defect, not evidence for criteria 3–17.
No ipmitool, authentication, NM/TEMP_IBC_NM read, Web login/capture, module/link action, log clear, BMC, host or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Opaque NM-domain sensor namespace reconciliation across complete IB/OOB IPMI and BMC Web
test_case.purpose: For every Project-SPEC-defined physical instance in the Master `NM` domain, verify the complete approved sensor namespace—including the source `TEMP_IBC_NM` mapping—matches expected identity, description, readings and states across IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and full BMC Web evidence.
required_package: Versioned authoritative definition of opaque label `NM` by physical FRU/function/location and complete installed instance population, without inferred acronym expansion
NM sensor namespace SPEC stating whether `TEMP_IBC_NM` is complete/partial/alias and enumerating every companion record, units, ranges/states, thresholds, freshness and applicability
Per-instance physical-to-IB-SDR/IB-list/OOB-SDR/OOB-list/Web crosswalk with stable record IDs
Approved ipmitool plus trusted protected OOB/Web access, aligned sampling and cache/rounding/stale/unavailable/pagination rules
Passive module/link/thermal stop context, raw/screenshot hashes, retained logs and human Web/verdict ownership
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; preserve `NM` as an opaque source label and bind only the approved Project-SPEC physical instances/namespace. Preserve logs. At aligned times capture complete untruncated IB and OOB `sdr elist`/`sensor list`; retain raw outputs before applying the NM crosswalk and `TEMP_IBC_NM` view. Capture all BMC Web Sensor pages with target, physical instance, time and navigation. Compare complete namespace population plus name/description/type/unit/reading/state/threshold/freshness against SPEC and across views. Never assume an NM expansion, equate one filter to full scope without SPEC, query the testcase title as a sensor, rely on grep/head alone, clear logs, alter modules/links or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved NM instance has exactly the complete SPEC-defined sensor namespace; `TEMP_IBC_NM` and companions map to the correct physical instance, all IB/OOB/Web fields and aligned readings/states conform, full Web evidence agrees and no disallowed module/link/thermal/log condition occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved NM physical definition and complete namespace, full raw IB/OOB and visual Web evidence, exact unique per-instance mapping and every required semantic value within SPEC/freshness rules. FAIL on guessed identity, incomplete TEMP-only scope, missing/extra/duplicate/misattributed record, wrong unit/state/threshold, stale/out-of-range value, cross-view mismatch or incomplete evidence. Missing NM definition/namespace is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Read-only only; prohibit module/link/configuration/sensor/threshold changes and log clearing.
Do not expand `NM` or infer TEMP_IBC_NM completeness; require signed Project-SPEC mapping after full raw capture.
Use protected trusted access and stop on physical-instance ambiguity, missing/duplicate map, stale data, link alarm or thermal excursion.
No automatic retry; preserve the first discrepancy, complete Web evidence and logs.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant and signed opaque-NM physical definition/instance population
Complete NM namespace SPEC with explicit TEMP_IBC_NM complete/partial/alias decision and five-view crosswalk
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR elist and Sensor list raw outputs, exits and hashes
Complete BMC Web screenshots/export with physical instance, pagination and timestamps
Passive module/link/thermal context, numbering-defect/no-guess/no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, access, NM mapping, namespace, sensor/Web mismatch, link/thermal or evidence fault, stop passive collection and preserve the first state. Close/revoke sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not rename/expand NM, control modules/links, clear logs or retry insecurely; escalate exact instance and record IDs to the platform/BMC owner.

source_conflict.reason: The opaque NM-to-TEMP_IBC_NM/companion relationship is explicitly delegated to a versioned Project crosswalk; no acronym or completeness is guessed, and all source views remain.

blocked.reason: Standard read paths, namespace comparison, visual evidence and recovery are defined; exact OEM NM identity/scope is runtime Project Configuration.
